notes.title: LUCID Demo : 1.0.1 Patch
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube="6pffPfsD5Xs;full"][/previewyoutube]
THANK YOU ALL SO MUCH 

I'm so grateful to everyone for playing the LUCID Demo. 

I cant believe how well the reception has been.



I have recently pushed a NEW PATCH that addresses the following:



- Totem Heads : larger Hit Box / No longer have timer that turns them off

- BOSS - Sentinel Bludgeon : lower health / lowered amount of pulses needed to Guard Break / Sentries in fight have lower hp

- speed up text reveal speed

- Reduced "Got Item" sequences by 1 second

- Lanterns that need to be touched after Touching a Crystal Basin : increase visibility / no longer have timer to turn Off

- Temple Circuit 1 - adjusted design difficulty (more save landings)

- Some more shards in overworld to help navigate player

- Increased Pause Menu Highlight Outline Selection visibility 



BUGS

- Fixed rare instance when moving between rooms player would appear out of level bounds

- Fixed certain objects not respawning

- Fixed certain objects not triggering if room is left while they were being activated


Again, thank you all for playing!

Please tell your friends to give the LUCID Demo a try, and to Add LUCID to their WISHLIST!

Cheers!

Eric
